screen.farandwide.help.index.title: Help Index
screen.farandwide.help.create.title: 1. Create a Route
screen.farandwide.help.create.body:
Go to the Edit Route screen from the Far and Wide Commands menu, from the Route Management screen, or use an assigned Minecraft hotkey.

A Route requires a name and a traversal type.  The traversal type determines how the vehicle will behave when it reaches the end of the route.
screen.farandwide.help.select.title: 2. Select a Route
screen.farandwide.help.select.body:
There may be multiple Routes available.  From the Route Management screen, select the Route you want to use.

When you create a new Route, it will automatically be selected.
screen.farandwide.help.waypoints.title: 3. Add Waypoints
screen.farandwide.help.waypoints.body:
Travel the intended path, adding Waypoints to the selected Route as you go.

To add the player's current position as a Waypoint, use the Add Waypoint command from the Far and Wide Commands menu, or (much easier) an assigned Minecraft hotkey.
screen.farandwide.help.assign.title: 4. Assign a Route
screen.farandwide.help.assign.body:
Once the Route has been defined, you can assign it to a supported vehicle (currently, boats or horses).  Ride the vehicle and use the Assign Route command from the Far and Wide Commands menu, or an assigned Minecraft hotkey.

If you assign a Route without being in a vehicle, the Route will be assigned directly to the player, in which case you can see and traverse the Route yourself.
screen.farandwide.help.activate.title: 5. Activate a Route
screen.farandwide.help.activate.body:
When a Route is assigned to a vehicle, you can activate it using the Activate Route command from the Far and Wide Commands menu, or an assigned Minecraft hotkey.  The vehicle will automatically travel to each Waypoint in the Route, following the traversal type defined for the Route.

You can pause or resume the Route at any time using the Toggle Route command from the Far and Wide Commands menu, or an assigned Minecraft hotkey.
screen.farandwide.help.cargo.create.body:
Cargo automation works with chest boats and with donkeys or mules equipped with chest storage. Add a normal waypoint where the vehicle should stop, aim at its marker, and use Edit Waypoint.

Choose Cargo behavior and a Load, Unload, or Unload then Load operation. Choose Normal to turn it back into an ordinary navigation waypoint.
screen.farandwide.help.cargo.stations.bo:
Select each required station, then aim at a nearby inventory and use it (right-click by default). The inventory must be loaded and within the waypoint's arrival radius.

A station cannot load on one waypoint and unload on another waypoint in the same route. An Unload then Load waypoint requires two different inventories.
Load moves items from the load station into the vehicle. Unload moves items from the vehicle into the unload station. Unload then Load performs those actions in that order.

The vehicle processes cargo after arriving, then continues according to the route's traversal type. Current load and unload filters accept all items.
screen.farandwide.help.terms.routes.body:
Route — An ordered path of waypoints.
Waypoint — A position the assigned traveler visits.
Selected route — The route that route-editing and assignment commands use.
Assignment — The link between a route and a vehicle or player.
Arrival radius — How close the traveler must get before a waypoint counts as reached.
Active / paused — Whether an assignment is currently moving.
screen.farandwide.help.terms.cargo.title: Terms: Traversal and Cargo
screen.farandwide.help.terms.cargo.body:
One Way — Follow the route once and stop at its end.
Loop — Continue from the last waypoint back to the first.
Reverse — Turn around at each end.
Cargo waypoint — A waypoint that performs an inventory transfer on arrival.
Cargo station — The inventory bound to a cargo waypoint.
Load / Unload — Move items into / out of the vehicle.
Filter — The item selection used for a transfer.
screen.farandwide.help.commands.routes.b:
Manage Routes — Create, edit, delete, and select routes.
Create Route — Create and automatically select a route.
Assign Route — Assign or unassign the selected route to the vehicle you are riding.
Toggle Route — Activate or pause the current assignment.
Add or Remove Waypoint — Remove the aimed-at marker, or add your current position.
Edit Waypoint — Edit the aimed-at waypoint's behavior, order, or arrival radius.
screen.farandwide.help.commands.other.bo:
Toggle HUD Visibility — Show or hide navigation guidance.
Help Screen — Open this guide.
Open Menu — Open the Far and Wide Commands menu.

The command menu shows each command's shortcut. Minecraft's Controls screen can assign or change key bindings.
